name: Denizli

queries.query: Denizli Turkey official cadastral parcel map municipal GIS TKGM land registry
queries.scope: Locate the local registry/cadastre owner and inspect safe public parcel geometry availability.
queries.result: The official city guide describes address/parcel search and drawing the selected parcel polygon with area. The public ArcGIS MapServer traced for the guide contains roads, buildings, neighborhoods and administrative/place layers, not cadastral parcels. The city guide’s parcel tool likely uses another backend, but its schema/anonymous geometry request was not verified. TKGM lists a Denizli Cadastre Directorate and an official public parcel-query service; its UI is identifier-oriented and no query was submitted.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search and official page/service review.
